name: oat
description: Ultra-lightweight, zero dependency, semantic HTML, CSS, JS UI library. ~10KB min+gz.
readmeExcerpt: # Oat UI > Semantic, minimal, zero dependencies. ~10KB CSS and JS. Oat is an ultra-lightweight HTML + CSS, semantic UI component library with zero dependencies. No framework, build, or dev complexity. Just include the tiny CSS and JS files and you are good to go building decent looking web applications with most commonly needed components and elements. Semantic tags and attributes are styled contextually out of the box without classes, forcing best practices, and reducing markup class pollution. A few dynamic components are WebComponents and use minimal JavaScript. I wrote this to use in my own projects after getting sick of the ridiculous bloat, dependencies, and rug-pulls in Javascript UI/component libraries. See live demo and docs at [**oat.ink**](https://oat.ink) **IMPORTANT:** The lib is currently sub v1 and is likely to have breaking changes until it hits v1. -------------
readmeHtml:
Oat UI

Semantic, minimal, zero dependencies. ~10KB CSS and JS.

Oat is an ultra-lightweight HTML + CSS, semantic UI component library with zero dependencies. No framework, build, or dev complexity. Just include the tiny CSS and JS files and you are good to go building decent looking web applications with most commonly needed components and elements.

Semantic tags and attributes are styled contextually out of the box without classes, forcing best practices, and reducing markup class pollution. A few dynamic components are WebComponents and use minimal JavaScript.

I wrote this to use in my own projects after getting sick of the ridiculous bloat, dependencies, and rug-pulls in Javascript UI/component libraries.

See live demo and docs at oat.ink

IMPORTANT: The lib is currently sub v1 and is likely to have breaking changes until it hits v1.

aiSummary.oneLiner: An ultra-lightweight, zero-dependency HTML and CSS component library enforcing strict semantic web standards.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Oat UI is a minimalist, dependency-free UI component library comprised of approximately 10KB of highly optimized CSS and JavaScript. It is specifically engineered to style standard, native HTML tags and attributes contextually, eliminating the need for complex utility classes or build toolchains. By avoiding heavy framework architectures, Oat encourages developers to adhere to strict semantic web best practices while drastically reducing HTML markup pollution. Furthermore, the library cleanly implements necessary dynamic interactive components utilizing modern, framework-agnostic native browser WebComponents.
keyFeatures: Zero dependencies architecture: Operates entirely without external CSS frameworks, complex Node build tools, or heavy JavaScript ecosystems.
Contextual semantic styling: Automatically applies highly readable, professional styles to native HTML elements based purely on their semantic structure.
Microscopic resource footprint: Maintains an ultra-lightweight size of around 10KB total across both CSS and JavaScript assets.
Classless markup enforcement: Drastically reduces HTML markup pollution and overall complexity by eliminating reliance on arbitrary CSS utility classes.
Native WebComponents integration: Implements necessary dynamic interactive components utilizing modern, highly performant native browser standards.
Rapid prototyping capabilities: Allows developers to instantly build decent-looking web applications using only a single CSS and JS file inclusion.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Web developers, designers, and system administrators who highly value correct semantic HTML and require a hyper-minimalist, dependency-free UI alternative.
